title: The Missing Part
subtitle: Withholding painful history makes a story incoherent
sourceCredit: Devan Sandiford · The Moth, “The Re-Education of a Black Father”

shot.title: A gap in the telling
shot.direction: The father tells a childhood story to a classroom; an erased part of the bubble stays conspicuous.
shot.soundDirection: Classroom murmur, eraser rubbing, a clear bell tone as the blank fills.

illustration.direction: Wide classroom. Father sits at the front with hands poised in a practiced storytelling gesture; attentive children form a loose semicircle. A single faint incomplete blank speech-outline shape on the wall beside him has a conspicuous missing section, indicating an omission without any readable words.

shot.title: A pointing child
shot.direction: A child points directly at the gap. The erasure trembles, not the child.
shot.soundDirection: Classroom murmur, eraser rubbing, a clear bell tone as the blank fills.

illustration.direction: Same classroom. The child in ochre raises a hand then points gently toward the gap beside the father. Father stops mid-gesture and meets the child’s gaze. Leave real space between them; classmates stay quietly attentive rather than demanding or comforting.

beats.caption: And that was the day I learned something important.
beats.speaker: FATHER

shot.title: The tidy ending
shot.direction: He finishes the partial story with a practiced ending.
shot.soundDirection: Classroom murmur, eraser rubbing, a clear bell tone as the blank fills.

illustration.direction: Wide classroom. Father sits at the front with hands poised in a practiced storytelling gesture; attentive children form a loose semicircle. A single faint incomplete blank speech-outline shape on the wall beside him has a conspicuous missing section, indicating an omission without any readable words.

beats.caption: But why wouldn’t they let you play?
beats.speaker: STUDENT

shot.title: Why could you not play
shot.direction: The child asks plainly. Keep space between the question and the father’s answer.
shot.soundDirection: Classroom murmur, eraser rubbing, a clear bell tone as the blank fills.

illustration.direction: Same classroom. The child in ochre raises a hand then points gently toward the gap beside the father. Father stops mid-gesture and meets the child’s gaze. Leave real space between them; classmates stay quietly attentive rather than demanding or comforting.

shot.title: Looking at the blank
shot.direction: His gaze goes to the missing section rather than away from the class.
shot.soundDirection: Classroom murmur, eraser rubbing, a clear bell tone as the blank fills.

illustration.direction: Father sits with hands lowered and open on his knees, looking directly at the children with a thoughtful, vulnerable expression. The faint incomplete blank speech-outline remains at the side, not covering faces. His posture accepts the hard part without asking the child to console him.

beats.caption: I left out the hard part because it hurt.
beats.speaker: FATHER

shot.title: The hard part hurt
shot.direction: He acknowledges the omission without positioning the child as responsible for comforting him.
shot.soundDirection: Classroom murmur, eraser rubbing, a clear bell tone as the blank fills.

illustration.direction: Father sits with hands lowered and open on his knees, looking directly at the children with a thoughtful, vulnerable expression. The faint incomplete blank speech-outline remains at the side, not covering faces. His posture accepts the hard part without asking the child to console him.

shot.title: Returning the missing piece
shot.direction: The empty portion of the bubble begins filling only as he makes room for the truth.
shot.soundDirection: Classroom murmur, eraser rubbing, a clear bell tone as the blank fills.

illustration.direction: Same father and classroom. He opens one hand in a careful, honest telling gesture; the once-incomplete pale speech-outline at the side becomes whole but remains entirely blank. Children listen with individual serious expressions. No historical reenactment, hateful imagery or vague kindness poster.

beats.caption: They excluded me because of racism. That belongs in the story.
beats.speaker: FATHER

shot.title: Naming racism
shot.direction: Preserve the explicit naming of racism. Do not replace it with a vague lesson about kindness.
shot.soundDirection: Classroom murmur, eraser rubbing, a clear bell tone as the blank fills.

He opens one hand in a careful, honest telling gesture; the once-incomplete pale speech-outline at the side becomes whole but remains entirely blank. Children listen with individual serious expressions. No historical reenactment, hateful imagery or vague kindness poster.

shot.title: Listening faces
shot.direction: The class listens; allow separate expressions and pauses.
shot.soundDirection: Classroom murmur, eraser rubbing, a clear bell tone as the blank fills.

illustration.direction: The child in ochre speaks from their own chair, one hand lightly raised toward their own chest. Father turns fully to listen and keeps his hands still. A separate small blank outline sits near the child, clearly distinct from the father’s, with no text and no merged biography.

shot.title: Another child’s experience
shot.direction: A student offers a separate experience. Their bubble does not merge into the father’s.

shot.title: Room for separate truths
shot.direction: Other distinct small bubbles become possible without inventing their wording.
shot.soundDirection: Classroom murmur, eraser rubbing, a clear bell tone as the blank fills.

illustration.direction: Wide final classroom. Father and children share a quiet circle with open listening postures and separate faces; no one performs a grand inspirational reaction. The two small blank speech-outline motifs stay distinct at the edge, leaving room for individual accounts. No moral is written over the scene.

shot.title: The whole story belongs
shot.direction: End with room for individual truthful accounts, no generic moral written over them.

production.arc: Protective omission → child’s question → truthful sharing
